purpose: Seven additional deposited-structure targets; compare synthetic MSAs with natural MSAs, no MSA, and enabled query-only MSA.
selection: Selected by deposited contiguous reference coverage and measured MSA depth before OpenFold outcomes. CspB excluded after depth screen in favor of antifreeze; its already queued DPLM generation retained outside the comparison.

dplm.acceptance: First 50 distinct canonical query-length variants; exclude exact query copies. No folding-score selection. Unmasked random positions preserve query context within each generation call.

openfold3.query: Same original protein sequence in every arm; variants serve only as MSA rows.
openfold3.no_msa_semantics: use_msas=False and use_main_msas=False; upstream featurizer supplies a gap row and zero profile. This does not remove the MSA neural-network layers.
openfold3.query_only_semantics: Query-only A3M with use_msas=True and use_main_msas=True, retaining query-derived MSA features.

natural_msa.deduplication: Distinct aligned rows after removal of lowercase insertions and dots; query excluded from depth counts.
natural_msa.natural_50: Random seed 42 sample of up to 50 distinct nonquery rows. Top7 has only four, so this is an order-permuted four-hit control, not a 50-hit condition.

limitations: Convenience sample of seven short proteins, not a held-out performance estimate; model training overlap is possible.
One generated pool and one model seed per arm; five diffusion samples are correlated.
Top7 is designed and its search hits are not established natural homologs.
CI2 and Top7 use resolved contiguous segments. Top7 MSE is mapped to methionine. Acylphosphatase is compared to the first deposited NMR model.
No templates or ligands; myoglobin reference contains heme, while prediction does not.
Search depth is not independent evolutionary information. Deep inputs exceed the model's 1024-row embedding cap.
No random-mutation MSA control or experimental validation of variant function.
